title: Rules & Rule Resolution
learning_objectives: Master PEGA's rule resolution algorithm and hierarchy
Understand rule inheritance and specialization patterns
Learn to optimize rule performance and maintainability

introduction.title: Understanding Rule Resolution in PEGA
introduction.text: Rule resolution is the sophisticated algorithm PEGA uses to determine which rule to execute when multiple rules with the same name exist. This fundamental concept enables powerful inheritance, specialization, and versioning capabilities that make PEGA applications highly maintainable and scalable.

sections.title: Rule Resolution Algorithm
sections.content: PEGA's rule resolution follows a precise algorithm that considers multiple factors to determine the best rule to execute.

resolution_factors.description: Rules in more specific classes take precedence over those in parent classes
Higher version numbers take precedence within the same ruleset
Circumstanced rules take precedence when conditions are met
resolution_factors.example: Rules with .Country='US' override base rules for US cases

resolution_factors.description: Available rules take precedence over withdrawn or blocked rules

sections.title: Rule Inheritance Patterns
sections.content: Understanding inheritance patterns is crucial for building maintainable PEGA applications.

inheritance_types.description: Child classes inherit rules from immediate parent classes
inheritance_types.use_case: Common functionality shared across related case types

inheritance_types.description: Classes inherit from framework patterns and templates

example.customization: Override specific rules while keeping framework benefits

inheritance_types.description: Implementing common interfaces across different class hierarchies
inheritance_types.use_case: Shared behaviors across unrelated case types

sections.title: Circumstancing and Specialization
sections.content: Circumstancing allows rules to be specialized based on runtime conditions without creating separate rule instances.

circumstance_types.description: Rules specialized based on property values
best_practices: Use single property circumstances for simple conditions
Ensure property values are stable and predictable

considerations: More complex to maintain and debug
Consider using when conditions for complex logic

circumstance_types.description: Rules that become effective at specific dates
circumstance_types.implementation: Use availability date ranges or date-based circumstances

sections.title: Ruleset Management and Versioning
sections.content: Effective ruleset management is essential for maintaining application integrity and enabling proper deployment strategies.

usage.major: Significant architectural changes or new major features
usage.minor: New features or enhancements within existing architecture

versioning_strategies.example: MyApp:01-02-03 → MyApp:01-03-01 for new feature release

versioning_strategies.approach: Separate rulesets for different features or modules

sections.title: Rule Optimization Techniques
sections.content: Optimizing rule resolution improves application performance and maintainability.

optimization_strategies.description: PEGA caches resolved rules to improve performance
best_practices: Use rule resolution trace to identify performance issues
Consider rule compilation for frequently used rules

optimization_strategies.description: Design class hierarchies to minimize resolution complexity
guidelines: Keep inheritance hierarchies shallow when possible
Group related functionality in appropriate class levels

optimization_strategies.description: Design circumstances to be efficient and maintainable
recommendations: Use the minimum number of properties needed
Order circumstances from most to least specific
Consider using when conditions for complex logic

sections.title: Debugging Rule Resolution
sections.content: Understanding how to debug rule resolution issues is crucial for PEGA developers.

debugging_tools.purpose: Shows the complete rule resolution process
usage: Analyze the resolution path and timing

debugging_tools.purpose: Shows which rules are being used at runtime
Detailed execution trace including rule resolution

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Rule resolution follows a predictable algorithm based on class hierarchy, version, circumstance, and availability
Inheritance patterns enable code reuse and maintainability through object-oriented design
Circumstancing provides powerful specialization capabilities without rule duplication
Effective ruleset management and versioning strategies are essential for application lifecycle management
Rule optimization techniques improve both performance and maintainability
Debugging tools help identify and resolve rule resolution issues efficiently
Advanced techniques like delegation and dynamic loading enable sophisticated application architectures
